sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Execution Payload Bid Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of execution payload bids from builder submission through validation and acceptance

nodes.label: Builder Registered and Active
nodes.description: Builder is in the builder registry with sufficient balance and active status verified via finalized checkpoint

nodes.label: Submit Execution Payload Bid
nodes.description: Builder creates SignedExecutionPayloadBid with value, blob commitments, parent block hash, and BLS signature

nodes.label: Bid Received by Proposer
nodes.description: Proposer has received a signed execution payload bid for the current slot

nodes.label: Validate Execution Payload Bid
nodes.description: Check: builder active status, sufficient balance (>= bid_value + MIN_DEPOSIT_AMOUNT + pending_withdrawals), valid BLS signature, matching slot/parent/randao, blob commitment limits

nodes.label: Bid Accepted and Cached
nodes.description: Bid passes validation and is cached as latest_execution_payload_bid in beacon state

nodes.label: Bid Rejected
nodes.description: Bid failed validation (insufficient balance, bad signature, wrong slot)

nodes.label: Process Execution Payload Envelope
nodes.description: Builder delivers ExecutionPayloadEnvelope with actual payload and builder signature, processed separately from block

nodes.label: Execution Payload Delivered
nodes.description: Builder has fulfilled the bid by delivering the execution payload

external_entities.name: Block Builder
external_entities.description: External builder entity submitting execution payload bids with MEV value

sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Payload Timeliness Committee (PTC)
sub_graphs.description: Models the PTC mechanism for attesting to payload availability and determining builder payment

nodes.label: PTC Committee Selected
nodes.description: 512 validators selected via balance-weighted selection for the payload timeliness committee

nodes.label: Check Payload and Blob Availability
nodes.description: PTC members verify that the execution payload and blobs are available for the current slot

nodes.label: Create Aggregated Payload Attestation
nodes.description: PTC members create PayloadAttestation with aggregated BLS signatures (max 4 per block)

nodes.label: Payload Attested as Present
nodes.description: Sufficient PTC members attested that the payload is available

nodes.label: Payload Attested as Absent
nodes.description: PTC members did not observe the payload, attesting it as missing

nodes.label: Process Builder Payment
nodes.description: During epoch processing, finalize builder payment if BUILDER_PAYMENT_THRESHOLD (6/10) quorum met

nodes.label: Builder Payment Finalized
nodes.description: Builder receives payment from its balance for delivering the payload

nodes.label: Builder Payment Withheld
nodes.description: Builder did not meet payment quorum; payment withheld

sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Builder Registry Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models builder deposit, activation, exit, and withdrawal flows in the builder registry

nodes.label: Builder Deposit Received
nodes.description: A builder deposit has been received and signature verified (processed immediately, no queue)

nodes.label: Verify Builder Deposit Signature
nodes.description: Verify BLS deposit signature for new builders; reusable builder indices after exit completion

nodes.label: Builder Active in Registry
nodes.description: Builder is active with pubkey, execution address, balance, and version tracking

nodes.label: Initiate Builder Voluntary Exit
nodes.description: Builder requests exit; must have zero pending withdrawals; withdrawable_epoch = current + MIN_BUILDER_WITHDRAWABILITY_DELAY (64 epochs)

nodes.label: Builder Exiting
nodes.description: Builder is in the exit period, awaiting MIN_BUILDER_WITHDRAWABILITY_DELAY (64 epochs)

nodes.label: Process Builder Withdrawal
nodes.description: Refund remaining balance to builder execution address; max 16384 builders per sweep

nodes.label: Builder Fully Withdrawn
nodes.description: Builder balance refunded, index available for reuse, pubkey cannot be reactivated

external_entities.name: Builder Operator
external_entities.description: External entity depositing funds and managing a builder in the registry

sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Withdrawal Processing Order
sub_graphs.description: Models the deterministic withdrawal processing order including builder and validator withdrawals

nodes.label: Epoch Boundary Reached
nodes.description: Block processing has reached epoch boundary, triggering withdrawal processing

nodes.label: Process Builder Pending Withdrawals
nodes.description: Process explicit pending withdrawal queue for builders (priority 1)

nodes.label: Process Partial Validator Withdrawals
nodes.description: Process validator excess balance withdrawals (priority 2)

nodes.label: Process Builder Sweep Withdrawals
nodes.description: Progressive iteration through builder registry for remaining balances, max 16384 per sweep (priority 3)

nodes.label: Process Validator Sweep Withdrawals
nodes.description: Progressive iteration through validator registry for sweep withdrawals (priority 4)

nodes.label: All Withdrawals Processed
nodes.description: All four withdrawal categories processed deterministically for this epoch

sub_graphs.title: Gloas: PBS Trust Boundaries
sub_graphs.description: Models the trust boundaries between proposers, builders, and the PTC in enshrined PBS

nodes.label: Proposer Self-Build Mode
nodes.description: Proposer builds its own payload; bid_amount must be zero regardless of withdrawal credentials

nodes.label: Verify Builder Bid BLS Signature
nodes.description: Verify BLS signature on SignedExecutionPayloadBid (skipped for self-builds)

nodes.label: Check Builder Balance Sufficiency
nodes.description: Verify builder balance >= bid_value + MIN_DEPOSIT_AMOUNT + pending_withdrawals

nodes.label: Validate Parent Block Fullness
nodes.description: Assert parent block is 'full' (previous bid was fulfilled with payload delivery)

nodes.label: Encode Builder Index with Flag
nodes.description: Apply BUILDER_INDEX_FLAG (2^40) bitwise OR to distinguish builder indices from validator indices in withdrawal routing

nodes.label: Withdrawal Correctly Routed
nodes.description: Withdrawal is routed to correct recipient based on BUILDER_INDEX_FLAG bit check

edges.label: Flag bit determines builder vs validator path

external_entities.name: External Block Builder
external_entities.description: Untrusted builder submitting bids that must be validated before acceptance

ambiguities.text: Bid amount zero required for self-builds regardless of withdrawal credentials - unclear why withdrawal credentials are mentioned in this context
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this means that even if a proposer has builder-style withdrawal credentials, self-build bids must have zero value to prevent self-payment exploits. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: Balance-weighted selection from all validators for PTC - unclear if this includes inactive or exiting validators
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume only active validators with non-zero effective balance are eligible for PTC selection. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: Index field in AttestationData signals payload availability state - unclear what specific values signal presence vs absence
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume a dedicated bit or enum in the index field distinguishes payload-present from payload-absent attestations. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: No specification of what happens if a builder's payload is partially available (some blobs missing)
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume partial availability is treated as absence for PTC attestation purposes. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: The PTC of 512 validators is assumed to be honest-majority for payload availability attestation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Dishonest PTC majority could falsely attest payload absence to deny builder payment, or falsely attest presence to pay builders who didn't deliver

implicit_assumptions.description: A builder cannot manipulate the BUILDER_INDEX_FLAG encoding to redirect withdrawals to unintended recipients
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Withdrawal routing could be exploited to steal funds from builders or validators

implicit_assumptions.description: Builder deposits are processed immediately without a queue, assuming the deposit transaction itself provides sufficient Sybil resistance
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker could rapidly register many builders to manipulate the builder registry or exhaust processing resources

implicit_assumptions.description: The two-phase block processing (bid in block, payload delivered separately) assumes network latency allows payload delivery within the slot
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Builders may consistently fail to deliver payloads in time, leading to empty slots and withheld payments despite honest behavior
